title: Privacy notice | {brand}
desc: What {brand} collects, why, and your rights under UK GDPR and US state privacy laws.
body:
The short version: we only collect your email address if you sign up for deal alerts. We don't use advertising cookies, and we never sell your data.

Who we are

{controller} is the data controller for {brand}. You can contact us at {email}.

What we collect

  • Deal alerts: your email address, your country, and a record of your consent. We use these only to send the alerts you asked for, until {alerts_end}, and we delete them within 30 days of that date.{alerts_processing}
  • Country choice: we remember the country you pick in your browser's local storage. It stays on your device and isn't sent to us.
  • Analytics: none at the moment. If we add any, we'll update this page and ask for consent where the law requires it.

Your choice

Giving us your email address is voluntary. You don't need to give it to use the site. If you don't, the only difference is that you won't get price-drop alerts. We don't make any automated decisions about you, and we don't profile you.

Shop links

When you click through to a retailer, that retailer and the affiliate network (for example Amazon, Awin, Partnerize or Impact) may set their own cookies to track the sale. Their privacy policies apply to that.

{law_html}

US residents

We don't sell or share personal information for cross-context behavioural advertising. You can ask us to tell you about, or delete, any information we hold by emailing {email}.

Changes

We'll post any changes on this page. Last updated: 15 November 2026.
